First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}-{9}^{2x-4}{x}^{2} & <-5\cdot {9}^{2x-4}-7\cdot {9}^{2x-4} \\ -{9}^{2x-4}{x}^{2}+5\cdot {9}^{2x-4}+7\cdot {9}^{2x-4} & <0 \\ (-{x}^{2}+5+7){9}^{2x-4} & <0 \\ (12-{x}^{2}){9}^{2x-4} & <0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${9}^{2x-4}$ and solve the resulting inequality using familiar techniques:

$$
\begin{aligned}12-{x}^{2} & <0 \\ -{x}^{2} & <-12 \\ {x}^{2} & >12 \\ \sqrt{{x}^{2}} & >\sqrt{12} \\ |x| & >2\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The solution to the inequality above is $x<-2\sqrt{3}$ or $x>2\sqrt{3}.$
